# AXIA News Tracker

> Live news aggregator (RSS/Atom only) updated ~every 10 min. All pages are plain Markdown with YAML frontmatter; item lines are `- [Title](url) — Source · HH:MM PT · #category #project $TICKER`.

Last sync: 2026-10-20 18:52 PT · 26020 items · 185/197 feeds OK
